# Adversarial Fixtures for HIR Artifact (U4.3)

**WARNING**: Every file in this directory contains deliberately corrupt postcard
data. Do not attempt to `load_fhir()` on these files outside a test harness
that expects `Err(HirArtifactError::*)`.

## File Layout

| File | Adversarial class | Expected `HirArtifactError` variant |
|---|---|---|
| `truncated_minimal.bin` | Truncated postcard stream | `Truncated` |
| `version_mismatch_99.bin` | Schema version 99 | `UnsupportedSchemaVersion { found: 99, expected: 2 }` |
| `version_mismatch_0.bin` | Schema version 0 | `UnsupportedSchemaVersion { found: 0, expected: 2 }` |
| `version_mismatch_1.bin` | Schema-v1 artifact | `UnsupportedSchemaVersion { found: 1, expected: 2 }` |
| `dangling_def_id.bin` | DefId beyond arena | `DanglingIndex { kind: "DefId", … }` |
| `dangling_hir_id.bin` | HirId beyond arena | `DanglingIndex { kind: "HirId", … }` |
| `dangling_type_id.bin` | TypeId beyond arena | `DanglingIndex { kind: "TypeId", … }` |
| `dangling_symbol.bin` | Symbol beyond interner | `DanglingIndex { kind: "interner", … }` |
| `cross_arena_dangle.bin` | FunctionFactTable DefId beyond HIR def arena | `DanglingIndex { kind: "DefId", … }` |
| `dangling_attachment_anchor.bin` | Attachment anchor with no owner | `DanglingIndex { kind: "HirSourceAnchorId", … }` |
| `duplicate_owner_anchor.bin` | Two owners sharing one anchor | `InvalidPresentation { issue: "duplicate_owner_anchor", … }` |
| `duplicate_attachment_owner.bin` | Two attachments naming one owner | `InvalidPresentation { issue: "duplicate_attachment_owner", … }` |
| `dangling_comment_symbol.bin` | CommentLine Symbol beyond interner | `DanglingIndex { kind: "Symbol", … }` |

## Loading for Tests

```rust
let bytes = include_bytes!("fixtures/hir_artifact/adversarial/truncated_minimal.bin");
let result = radix::hir::artifact::load_fhir(bytes);
assert!(matches!(result, Err(HirArtifactError::TruncatedArtifact)));
```

## Code of Fixture Generation

Fixtures are generated by hand: serialize a minimal `HirArtifact` (via
`minimal_test_artifact()` from `crates/radix/src/hir/artifact.rs` tests), apply
the corruption, and write the bytes. No automated generator.
